title: IICS Developer/Mclean, VA (Onsite) 6+ months
description:
Informatica Developer – Data Warehousing & ETL
Role is 5 days a week onsite McLean, VA - local candidates only
6+ months

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Informatica Developer to design, build, and optimize enterprise data integration and data warehouse solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SQL, data warehouse concepts, and data loading/comparison mechanisms to support complex ETL workflows and ensure data accuracy, consistency, and scalability across business-critical systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain ETL workflows using Informatica PowerCenter/Cloud to support enterprise data integration needs.
Implement data loading strategies for large-scale structured and semi-structured data.
Develop efficient SQL queries, stored procedures, and performance tuning for optimal data processing.
Work with data warehouse concepts (fact tables, dimension tables, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, partitioning, indexing).
Design and implement data comparison and reconciliation mechanisms to ensure data quality and consistency across systems.
Collaborate with data architects, analysts, and business teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical ETL solutions.
Perform data profiling, cleansing, and validation to support business reporting and analytics.
Optimize ETL pipelines for scalability, performance, and reliability.
Participate in code reviews, debugging, and production support for ETL processes.
Work with version control, CI/CD, and scheduling tools for deployment and automation of data workflows.
What You'll Bring with You
5+ years of experience as an Informatica Developer in enterprise data warehouse environments.
Strong expertise in SQL (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or similar), including performance tuning.
Deep understanding of data warehouse concepts (ETL/ELT, OLAP/OLTP, dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas).
Hands-on experience in data loading techniques (incremental loads, CDC, batch, streaming).
Strong knowledge of data comparison and reconciliation mechanisms for validating large data sets.
Experience with ETL performance optimization and error handling.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms (AWS Redshift, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, or GCP BigQuery) is a plus.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills for ETL and data issues.
Ability to work in Agile teams, collaborating with business and technical stakeholders.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical solutions to non-technical users.

title: Collibra Data Governance/Data Quality-McLean, VA (Onsite)-6 months
description:
Title: Collibra Data Governance/Data Quality

Location: McLean, VA (On-site 5 days /week)

Duration: 6+ months

Must have DGC

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on consultant with deep proficiency in both Collibra Data Governance Center (DGC) and Collibra Data Quality (CDQ). This role is critical to helping our team mature our data quality governance framework, integrate data quality rules into enterprise processes, and operationalize end-to-end rule lineage and stewardship in Collibra. Candidates must be comfortable configuring Collibra workflows, enabling DQ dashboards, and supporting teams in the use of profiling and monitoring features. Experience with Informatica Cloud Data Quality is a strong plus.

Key Responsibilities • Configure and deploy Collibra DGC workflows that support data quality rule creation, approval, escalation, and monitoring • Establish traceability between data quality rules, data domains, and controls using Collibra's governance models • Integrate Collibra DGC and CDQ, ensuring metadata flow, score synchronization, and issue routing is working as intended • Support business teams in operationalizing rule onboarding, rule ownership, and issue tracking via Collibra • Build out data quality dashboards and reports in Collibra • Work with governance leads to align DQ rules with BWise control frameworks or similar • Collaborate with Collibra platform administrators to define best practices • Deliver training and documentation to build internal adoption

Required Skills & Experience • 5+ years working in data governance, metadata, or data quality domains • 3+ years of hands-on experience configuring and using Collibra DGC • 3+ years of hands-on experience using Collibra Data Quality (CDQ): o Profiling setup and interpretation o Rule results integration o Score and issue reporting • Experience designing and modifying Collibra workflows (BPMN 2.0) • Strong understanding of data quality dimensions, rule structures, and governance models • Familiarity with Snowflake, SQL, and common enterprise data platforms • Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills

Big Plus Skills • Working knowledge of Informatica Cloud Data Quality (ICDQ) including rule setup and profiling • Familiarity with issue tracking tools like ServiceNow • Understanding of lineage capture and asset modeling in Collibra • Exposure to Collibra Edge, REST APIs, or bulk asset loaders

Ideal Candidate • Brings real-world experience implementing Collibra tools—not just theoretical knowledge • Comfortable working directly with business and data teams to bridge requirements and technical solutions • Able to configure, test, and document solutions independently • Has a data-first mindset and understands how data quality drives business value

title: Collibra Data Lineage Automation Engineer / McLean, VA- 6+ months
description:
Collibra Data Lineage Automation Engineer
McLean, VA
6+ months
Role is on-site in McLean 5 days per week

We are seeking a highly experienced Data Lineage Automation Engineer to lead the design and implementation of automated end-to-end lineage solutions across a highly heterogeneous enterprise data ecosystem. This role requires deep technical expertise in lineage frameworks (such as Spline and OpenLineage), experience across cloud and legacy environments, and a strong AI foundation to support intelligent metadata extraction and traceability.
Key Responsibilities • Lead the implementation of automated data lineage across a complex data estate that includes: o Cloud platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS) o Legacy relational databases and ETLs o NoSQL data stores o BI/reporting platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) • Implement or extend frameworks such as Spline, OpenLineage, or similar open frameworks to support active lineage capture • Build connectors, extractors, or agents where necessary to bridge gaps between systems and lineage frameworks • Integrate with metadata platforms (e.g., Collibra) to publish lineage in a consumable format • Apply AI/ML techniques to infer lineage where automation is incomplete (e.g., handling Java based ETLs), using logs, query patterns, or usage metadata • Develop reusable lineage components for operational reuse across domains • Guide stakeholders on best practices for lineage standardization, storage, and use
Required Skills & Experience • Proven experience delivering automated data lineage solutions across hybrid architectures • Hands-on expertise with Spline, OpenLineage, Marquez, or comparable lineage frameworks • Deep understanding of metadata capture, ETL process tracing, and query execution mapping • Strong AI/ML background — particularly in metadata intelligence, natural language processing for code parsing, or pattern detection • Experience integrating lineage with data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation, etc.) • Strong programming background in Python, Scala, or Java • Deep familiarity with SQL and query logs from systems like Snowflake, SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, etc.
Big Plus Skills • Experience with third-party commercial data lineage solutions a plus (evaluations and implementations) • Prior work in regulated environments (e.g., financial services, healthcare) • Familiarity with event-based architectures for real-time lineage propagation • Knowledge of data mesh or domain-driven lineage strategies
Ideal Candidate • Has successfully implemented automated lineage at enterprise scale • Operates at the intersection of data engineering, metadata management, and AI • Can act as a technical thought partner to architecture teams and governance leads • Brings the mindset of automation-first and reuse-oriented design
